Arviva Therapeutics has built a fully integrated R&D platform—spanning bioinformatics, peptide synthesis, in vitro screening, and experimental animal models—enabling innovative drug discovery from the earliest stages and accelerating the journey from concept to clinic.

R&D Platform

Headquarters Overview

The headquarters comprises the main office building, a new drug R&D center, and a biopharmaceutical production base, supporting the company’s expanding business and its ambition to become a global leader.

Strategic Focus:

1.Comprehensively Build a New Drug Development Base – Establishing a robust foundation for innovative drug discovery and development.

2.Overcome Challenges in New Drug Formulation R&D – Driving breakthroughs in complex drug development.

3.Adhere to High-Quality Development – Ensuring excellence across all operations and products.

4.Promote Sustainable and Harmonious Development – Balancing growth with environmental stewardship and social responsibility.
